text: dsh-tui-pro 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的全屏终端工作台。它通过 TUI 插件和 profile bundle 接入 dsh，将固定助手与多个项目会话组织在同一工作区。用户可以创建、切换和浏览会话，查看运行状态与上下文，调整模型和主题，控制会话记忆，并将对话导出为 Markdown。适合需要在一个终端中持续处理多个项目的 dsh 用户。需要 dsh CLI、兼容版本的 Node.js 和支持 ANSI 的终端。

dsh-tui-pro is a terminal workbench for DeepSeek Harness, combining a durable Assistant with project sessions. It supports session switching, status and context views, model and theme selection, memory controls, and Markdown transcript export for dsh users managing projects in one terminal.
想在一个终端里管理多个项目的 dsh 会话。
如何在终端界面快速切换不同项目的对话？
我想保留一个长期助手，同时为每个项目开独立会话。
能不能浏览以前的会话并恢复某个项目的工作？
让终端聊天界面同时显示多个活跃项目。
有没有办法把当前对话另存成 Markdown 文件？
I want to manage several project conversations in one terminal.
How can I switch between persistent coding sessions from a terminal UI?
dsh-tui-pro 的功能「多项目会话」：在项目工作区中保留活跃会话，并可创建或切换项目会话。使用 `/new` 创建会话，`/switch`、快捷键或侧栏进行切换。
dsh-tui-pro 的功能「固定助手」：提供独立于项目工作区的持久助手会话，并允许从项目会话返回助手。使用 `/assistant` 切换到该会话。
dsh-tui-pro 的功能「会话记忆」：允许查看或切换当前会话的长期记忆状态。使用 `/memory on` 或 `/memory off` 控制记忆开关。
dsh-tui-pro 的功能「会话导出」：把会话中的用户、助手消息和待办内容整理成 Markdown 文件。通过 `/export` 命令触发并写入当前工作目录。

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · Quick start：You need Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` and `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` configured outside this repository.

Already have the [`dsh` CLI](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)? Install the plugin and its profile layer once:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile tui add @lk251066/dsh-tui
```

Then launch it from any project directory:

```bash
dsh --profile tui
```

Without a global dsh installation, use the same profile through `npx`:

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · Quick start：```bash
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest plugin --profile tui add @lk251066/dsh-tui
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest --profile tui
```

The package owns both the TUI plugin and its `cordis.patch.yml` profile layer. No second bundle package is required.

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · One terminal, multiple projects：The Assistant is one durable session outside every project workspace. It keeps a permanent working directory and continues the same conversation across launches; bounded context is renewed through dsh compaction while the durable log and plugin-local long-term memory remain available. Active project sessions stay grouped by workspace in the fixed sidebar.

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · A stable full-screen canvas：Only the transcript scrolls. The editor, current plan, live status, model, context usage, and active sessions remain in place while user messages, Markdown, thinking, tools, diffs, plans, todos, and subagents use distinct compact treatments.

The terminal title keeps the mounted session name visible. While work is active, a low-frequency spinner and the total number of running sessions appear in the title, and supported terminals also expose a taskbar progress state.

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · Native DeepSeek Harness composition：The package is an out-of-tree dsh plugin bundle, not a fork of the harness. Sessions, tools, skills, models, permissions, compaction, and subagents continue to use the services provided by the selected dsh profile.

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · Session workflow：Launching from a directory opens its first manually ordered active project session. If the directory has none, dsh creates one and adds it to that workspace.

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · Session workflow：- `/new` creates another session in the current project.
- `/new <path>` creates a session for another project.
- `/assistant` returns to the fixed Assistant.
- `/switch`, `Alt+Left`, `Alt+Right`, or a sidebar click changes the active project session.
- `/quit` closes the current project session, preserves its history, and returns to the Assistant.
- `/sessions` browses complete history; `/exit` closes the TUI.

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · Session workflow：The Assistant can manage active project sessions and read their completed user/assistant dialogue. Hidden reasoning, tool traffic, and unfinished output are not exposed across sessions.

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · Session workflow：Assistant replies always remain fully rendered; transcript scrolling handles long answers. Thinking and tool bodies can collapse, but a tool's identity, status, and failure remain visible. Memory is enabled for the Assistant by default and persists durable user facts without silently evicting older records; `/memory off` removes memory from that session's model context without deleting it.

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · Interaction：| Action | Control |
| --- | --- |
| Send immediate steering | `Enter` while a turn is running |
| Queue the next turn | `Tab` |
| Recover the latest queued message | `Esc` before cancellation |
| Recall the latest submission | Empty-input `Up` |
| Browse current-conversation checkpoints | Double `Esc` |
| Toggle tool and context body detail | `Ctrl+O` |
| Expand settled reasoning | `Ctrl+R` |
| Select and copy transcript text | Drag with the left mouse button |
| Attach a clipboard image | `Alt+V` |
| Control session memory | `/memory`, `/memory on`, `/memory off` |

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · Interaction：Run `/help` for the complete command list. Models, reasoning effort, skills, themes, settings, permissions, questions, and approvals use the fixed bottom area instead of centered popup windows.

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · Images and terminals：`@` completes workspace files. `Alt+V` attaches a clipboard image when the selected model advertises image input. Windows uses PowerShell to read clipboard images, macOS requires `pngpaste`, and Linux requires `wl-paste` or `xclip`.

The TUI requires an ANSI-capable terminal. The sidebar hides below 65 inner columns, and a terminal height of at least 24 rows is recommended.

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: tui
  name: '@lk251066/dsh-tui'
  config:
    sidebarWidth: 32

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · 稳定的全屏工作区：只有聊天记录区域滚动。输入框、当前计划、实时状态、模型、上下文用量和活跃会话保持固定；用户消息、Markdown、思考、工具、diff、计划、todo 和子代理使用紧凑且可区分的样式。

终端标题始终保留当前会话名称。存在正在执行的会话时，标题会显示低频动画和当前运行会话总数，支持该终端协议的环境也会在任务栏显示进度状态。
@lk251066/dsh-tui README · 使用原生 DeepSeek Harness 组合：这个包是独立于 dsh 仓库的插件 bundle，不是 Harness 分支。会话、工具、skills、模型、权限、上下文压缩和子代理仍然使用当前 dsh profile 提供的服务。
section: 使用原生 DeepSeek Harness 组合

text:
@lk251066/dsh-tui README · 会话工作流：在某个目录启动时，会打开该目录中手动排序最靠前的活跃项目会话。如果不存在，dsh 会新建会话并加入该工作区。

- `/new` 在当前项目中创建另一个会话。
- `/new <路径>` 为另一个项目创建会话。
- `/assistant` 返回固定助手。
- `/switch`、`Alt+Left`、`Alt+Right` 或点击侧边栏可以切换活跃项目会话。
- `/quit` 关闭当前项目会话、保留历史并返回助手。
- `/sessions` 浏览完整历史；`/exit` 关闭整个 TUI。

助手可以管理活跃项目会话，并读取其中已完成的用户和助手对话。隐藏思考、工具过程和未完成输出不会跨会话暴露。

助手最终回复始终完整显示，长内容只通过聊天区域滚动查看。思考和工具正文可以收起，但工具名称、状态和错误始终可见。助手默认启用长期记忆，旧记录不会因达到固定条数而被静默删除；`/memory off` 只停止当前会话使用记忆，不删除已保存内容。

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · 交互方式：| 操作 | 指令或按键 |
| --- | --- |
| 当前回合中立即追加消息 | `Enter` |
| 将消息排到下一回合 | `Tab` |
| 取消前取回最新排队消息 | `Esc` |
| 恢复最近一次提交 | 空输入时按 `Up` |
| 浏览当前对话检查点 | 双击 `Esc` |
| 切换工具和上下文正文详情 | `Ctrl+O` |
| 展开已完成的思考 | `Ctrl+R` |
| 选择并复制聊天文本 | 按住鼠标左键拖动 |
| 附加剪贴板图片 | `Alt+V` |
| 控制当前会话记忆 | `/memory`、`/memory on`、`/memory off` |

运行 `/help` 可以查看完整指令。模型、思考等级、skills、主题、设置、权限、问题和审批选择器都在底部固定区域显示，不使用居中弹窗。

@lk251066/dsh-tui README · 图片与终端：`@` 可以补全工作区文件。所选模型明确支持图片输入时，`Alt+V` 可附加剪贴板图片。Windows 使用 PowerShell 读取图片，macOS 需要 `pngpaste`，Linux 需要 `wl-paste` 或 `xclip`。

TUI 需要支持 ANSI 转义序列的终端。内部宽度低于 65 列时侧边栏会隐藏，建议终端高度至少为 24 行。
